title: pvIntegrateVariables
body:
## pvIntegrateVariables

Integrates every point and cell array over the input cells and sums the total length, area or volume; the output is a single point with one vertex cell holding the results. Only cells of the highest dimension present are used (with lines, triangles and hexahedra mixed, only the hexahedra count) and vertices are ignored. Same native filter as the curated integrate; use it for totals such as a surface-integrated flux or a volume-integrated quantity.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Integrals are not averages: point-data integrals are never divided by the size; divide them yourself (calculator) or use DivideCellDataByVolume for cell data.
- Vectors are integrated component by component; a flux needs a normal-component field on the surface, not the raw velocity.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `IntegrateVariables`. Identity: `filters/IntegrateAttributes`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Integrate Attributes filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DivideCellDataByVolume` | This option concerns the output cell data. If it is turned on, then each value in the output cell data will be divided by the total length/area/volume. If the dataset is distributed among MPI nodes, the total length/volume/area is is the sum of the individual total contributions from all pieces. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvIntegrateVariables",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
